correctness.rationale: Normalized monomial reciprocal norms are gamma ratios b_j. Their increments have the positive Hausdorff-moment representation; D(u)=(1-u)F(u)=1+∫u/(1-t^k u)dμ. Strict positive imaginary-part sign off real axis and strict D prime>0 on (-1,0) exclude nonreal and multiple roots, with D(-1)=1-J. J(k) increases continuously from J(1)=1-2^-eps to infinity, giving unique real kappa and exact boundary convention. On induced E_k space, division by w-a identifies one-dimensional wandering kernel F(a w), while invertible multipliers and boundary (1+w) cyclic approximation give a<=r and strict a>r noncyclic via point evaluations. Differentiated gamma-ratio control and Abel eta series yield J=2k^eps eta(-eps)/Gamma(1+eps)-1+O(k^(eps-1)), uniformly near eps=0; monotonic bracketing gives prefactor pi e^-gamma/2. Independently integrated J at eps=.25,.5,.8 and k=1,2,3,5,12,64 (monotone and k=1 identity); all are finite checks of the analytic proof.
